decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 10 backtested attempts, score 0.9661. Series context: trend strength 0.5598 and seasonal strength 0.6487; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.115); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.408.
